name: absent
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.graphId='absent' AND substring('x','bad')='x' RETURN n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: absent-distinct
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.graphId='absent' AND substring('x','bad')='x' RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: present-cross
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.graphId='b' AND substring('x','bad')='x' RETURN n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: present-cross-distinct
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.graphId='b' AND substring('x','bad')='x' RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS x LIMIT 1
